content_sections.heading: Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Ambedkar Nagar Hospital Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 6th August 2026 and 7th August 2026. Candidates should report on these dates.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Junior Resident.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Resident post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree recognized by MCI and be registered with the Delhi Medical Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years, with relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered?
faq.answer: The salary will be as per Level-10 of the 7th Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC, SC/ST categories.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and registration certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Ambedkar Nagar Hospital located?
faq.answer: Ambedkar Nagar Hospital is located in Delhi, with the pincode 110062.
